```{r load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)
library(posterior)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(VennDiagram)
```

```{r Load data}
bee_data <- read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "cleaned", "bee_data.csv"),
           stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
           check.names = FALSE)

rldata <- read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "raw", "rldata.csv"),
           stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
           check.names = FALSE)
```

Venn Diagram of species composition
```{r}
# Get species present in each site type
species_focal   <- names(which(colSums(bee_data[bee_data$site == "focal",   species_cols] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))
species_control <- names(which(colSums(bee_data[bee_data$site == "control", species_cols] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

# Quick check
length(species_focal)
length(species_control)
length(intersect(species_focal, species_control))

n_focal      <- length(species_focal)
n_control    <- length(species_control)
n_shared     <- length(intersect(species_focal, species_control))
n_only_focal   <- n_focal   - n_shared
n_only_control <- n_control - n_shared

grid.newpage()
venn <- draw.pairwise.venn(
  area1          = n_focal,
  area2          = n_control,
  cross.area     = n_shared,
  category       = c("Focal", "Control"),
  fill           = c("#2C7FB8", "#D95F09"),
  alpha          = 0.4,
  col            = "white",
  cex            = 1.8,
  cat.cex        = 1.5,
  cat.col        = c("#2C7FB8", "#D95F09"),
  cat.fontface   = "bold",
  fontfamily     = "sans",
  cat.fontfamily = "sans",
  margin         = 0.08,
  cat.pos        = c(-20, 20),
  cat.dist       = 0.06
)
```

```{r print venn diagram bee species by site}
tiff("../output/figures/venn_species_sites.tiff",
     width = 3000, height = 2500, res = 600, compression = "lzw")
grid.draw(venn)
dev.off()
```


RL status df
```{r}
start <- match("Andrena aeneiventris", names(bee_data))
end   <- match("Stelis punctulatissima", names(bee_data))
species_cols <- start:end


species_names <- names(bee_data)[species_cols]


clean_names <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_trim() |>
    str_to_lower()
}

species_df <- tibble(
  species = species_names,
  species_clean = clean_names(species_names)
)

rldata_clean <- rldata |>
  mutate(species_clean = clean_names(ESP))

# join Rl status to bee_data
rl_lookup <- species_df |>
  left_join(rldata_clean, by = "species_clean")

# set levels of interest
rl_levels <- c("NT", "VU", "EN", "CR")

rl_species <- rl_lookup |>
  filter(RL_2022 %in% rl_levels) |>
  pull(species)

# Venn groups
species_shared        <- intersect(species_focal, species_control)
species_only_focal    <- setdiff(species_focal, species_control)
species_only_control  <- setdiff(species_control, species_focal)

rl_focal_only    <- intersect(species_only_focal, rl_species)
rl_control_only  <- intersect(species_only_control, rl_species)
rl_shared        <- intersect(species_shared, rl_species)


cat("\n--- FOCAL ONLY (Red List) ---\n\n")
cat(paste(sort(rl_focal_only), collapse = "\n"))

cat("\n\n--- CONTROL ONLY (Red List) ---\n\n")
cat(paste(sort(rl_control_only), collapse = "\n"))

cat("\n\n--- SHARED (Red List) ---\n\n")
cat(paste(sort(rl_shared), collapse = "\n"))
# Species list added to Venn Diagram in separate sofwtware
```
